projects.name: Oxyra API
projects.summary: The library the other Oxyra mods share: their settings, drawn and kept on their page in Options > Mods.
projects.description: Required by every other mod of this library.

projects.name: BetterF3
projects.summary: The F3 screen as coloured modules in two columns, sliding in and out.
projects.description: Port of cominixo's and TreyRuffy's BetterF3 (MIT): Minecraft, FPS, Graphics, Server, Coordinates, Chunks, Location, Entities, Sounds, Help, Misc / System, Targeted; each module on or off and coloured.

projects.name: Immersive Portals
projects.summary: See through Nether and End portals and cross them without a loading screen.
projects.description: After qouteall's Immersive Portals: the level behind a portal drawn through it, the crossing landing where the view showed. Single player and LAN host.

projects.name: Mod Menu
projects.summary: A Mods button on the title screen and the pause menu, and Options > Mods laid out as Mod Menu does.
projects.description: After TerraformersMC's Mod Menu: the mod list with search, sorting, libraries, details and each mod's settings.

projects.name: Mouse Tweaks
projects.summary: Drag and wheel controls in inventories.
projects.description: After YaLTeR's Mouse Tweaks: right-drag places one per slot, left-drag gathers, Shift-drag moves every slot, the wheel moves one item.

projects.name: Particle Core
projects.summary: Draws only the particles you can see, for more frames.
projects.description: Skips particles out of view, past a distance or past a per-frame limit, each with its setting.

projects.name: Physics
projects.summary: Broken blocks, explosions and dead mobs fall apart; doors and trapdoors swing.
projects.description: Inspired by haubna's Physics Mod (its behaviour only): broken blocks crumble in tumbling cubes, explosions throw debris, mobs fall as jointed ragdolls you can push and hit, doors and trapdoors swing on a damped spring.

projects.name: ShulkerBoxTooltip
projects.summary: A container's contents in its tooltip.
projects.description: Port of MisterPeModder's ShulkerBoxTooltip (MIT): Shift for the compact preview, Alt as well for the full one, Control to lock it; themes, positions and colours.
